destination.name: Lismore
destination.tagline: The Northern Rivers regional centre on the Wilsons River, with rainforest and Nimbin close by.
destination.description: Lismore is the largest urban centre in the Northern Rivers, on a floodplain beside the Wilsons River, 30 km inland from Ballina. Its Rural Street gallery is free, and Nimbin, the counterculture village that grew from the 1973 Aquarius Festival, is a short drive away. Nightcap National Park, part of the World Heritage rainforests, was created in 1983 after logging blockades at Terania Creek, and its Minyon Falls lookout looks over a drop of more than 100 m. The city centre floods when the river rises, most severely in 2022.
whyVisit: See Minyon Falls plunge over cliffs

goodToKnow.title: Check road closures
goodToKnow.detail: Nightcap National Park's roads can close after heavy rain, so check NPWS alerts before driving to Minyon Falls.

goodToKnow.title: Gallery open late Thursday
goodToKnow.detail: Lismore Regional Gallery is free and open 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM, with Thursday opening until 6:00 PM.

goodToKnow.title: No flights into Lismore
goodToKnow.detail: Commercial passenger flights ended in June 2022; Ballina Byron Gateway Airport, about 34 km away, is the nearest.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Autumn and spring, {months}, are mild for rainforest walks; the Wilsons River floods after high rainfall, so heavy-rain months carry road and closure risk.
